Which stream universe a `from_head` `Wait` cursor has already snapshotted
into explicit `positions`.

StageTarget.description: What the focused sidebar node shows on the stage.

oneOf.description: Notifications and BB approval cards.
A project `#channel`, a `#wave-<slug>` room, a global channel, or a DM.
One wave agent's context window and BB thread.
Operator configuration and live runner/courier health (`StreamId::Config`).

StreamId.description: The identity of one single-writer log. Also the actor address.

oneOf.description:
One inbox per principal: notifications + read cursors. The only owner
of "what has X seen", so unread = room head (room) - cursor (inbox),
merged at the read boundary (per separate-before-serializing-shared-state).
The mail bridge's promotion / ack ledger (sandbox only).
Durable seat records and ephemeral live session bindings.
Operator configuration ledger synced with `~/.config/rex-wave/config.toml`.

SystemPart.description: The daemon-internal parts allowed to issue `Audience::System` commands.

inputSchema.description:
`channel_wait`. Returns as soon as `interest` matches anything after
`after`, with the *whole* catch-up slice (never just the trigger), or an
empty page at `timeout_ms`.

cursor.description:
Optional resume cursor; when present, takes precedence over `after`'s
single-stream fallback and combines with `room` / `since`.

room.description:
Optional target room reference (`#channel`, `@seat`); when present, the
server resolves `since` and `cursor` against the server-selected stream
(while `after` carries a compatibility fallback for older daemons).

since.description:
Optional room-relative sequence offset (`--since` / `--after`), applied
exclusively to the server-selected `room` stream when `room` is present.
